title: Lifelong learning is becoming increasingly important in response to labour market transformations
title_zh: 终身学习在应对劳动力市场转型中的重要性日益凸显
authors: Isaure Delaporte, Verónica Escudero, Hannah Liepmann
official: 官方在线 2026-07-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: As digital, environmental, and demographic transformations reshape labour markets, skills influence who benefits from these changes and who falls behind. This column presents the findings of an International Labour Organization report that shows that socio-emotional and cognitive skills are in high demand and that employers seek rounded skills profiles. However, most countries still lack ambitious lifelong learning systems. The inclusiveness, quality, and adaptability of such systems will influence how economies and societies navigate structural transformation.
abstract_zh: 随着数字化、环境与人口结构的转型重塑劳动力市场，技能决定了谁能从这些变革中受益、谁又将落后。本专栏介绍了国际劳工组织一份报告的研究发现：社会情感技能与认知技能需求旺盛，雇主更青睐综合型技能人才。然而，多数国家仍缺乏具有前瞻性的终身学习体系。这类体系的包容性、质量与适应性，将深刻影响各经济体与社会如何应对结构性转型。

title: Economic Models of Identity Formation and Cultural Transmission
title_zh: DP21761 身份形成与文化传播的经济学模型
authors: Alberto Bisin, Thierry Verdier
official: 官方在线 2026-07-18 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: In this paper we survey recent advances in the economic theory of identity formation. We restrict our analysis to models which conceptualize identity formation as embedded into an inter-generational cultural transmission process, and therefore have implications for the dynamics of social identity. Through the lens of a general framework linking identity formation to cultural evolution, we discuss issues related to the dynamics of oppositional, racial, or minority attitudes, cultural polarization, identity switching, and openness to alternative identities. An application of the set-up to multidimensional identities constructed from combinations of characteristics, provides conditions under which societies converge (or not) toward narrow identities centered on salient markers such as religion, ethnicity, or race. We conclude by outlining promising avenues for future research.
abstract_zh: 本文综述了身份认同形成的经济学理论最新进展。我们将分析范围限定于将身份认同形成嵌入代际文化传播过程的模型，这类模型对社会身份认同的动态演变具有重要启示。通过构建连接身份认同形成与文化演化的通用分析框架，我们探讨了对抗性态度、种族或少数群体态度、文化极化、身份转换以及对替代性身份认同的开放性等议题的动态特征。将该框架应用于由多重特征组合构建的多维身份认同，揭示了社会在何种条件下会（或不会）收敛于以宗教、族裔或种族等显著标识为核心的狭隘身份认同。最后，我们指出了未来研究富有前景的方向。

title: Voluntary Collective Action to Address Growing Agricultural Challenges in Two Countries: Experimental Insights and Commonalities
title_zh: 两国应对日益严峻农业挑战的自愿集体行动：实验洞见与共性
authors: Ariel Singerman, Sergio H. Lence
official: 官方在线 2026-07-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We conducted two framed field economic experiments with citrus farmers in Florida, United States and soybean farmers in Argentina to investigate their willingness to coordinate pest and weed management efforts. Despite the contrast between these two agricultural contexts, we find striking behavioral commonalities. In both countries, farmers display aversion to strategic uncertainty, rely heavily on beliefs about their neighbors' actions when deciding whether to participate, and systematically underestimate the probability of successful coordination even when opportunity costs are low. These common findings across such different settings suggest that the underlying mechanisms are not context‐specific but instead reflect more general features of decision‐making under strategic interdependence, lending support to the external validity of our findings. The results highlight key psychological and economic barriers to cooperation and offer policy‐relevant insights for designing interventions to enhance participation in voluntary area‐wide pest management programs. While voluntary coordination can enhance pest management effectiveness and be pareto‐optimal, the success of the collective action depends on overcoming farmers' reluctance to participate. The evidence that farmers systematically underestimate the probability of successful coordination even when opportunity costs are low highlights a key behavioral barrier that can lead to coordination failures. Interventions that mitigate strategic uncertainty and build trust among participants—such as targeted subsidies or technical assistance—could encourage participation among farmers who would otherwise be unwilling to engage in coordinated efforts. Beyond the immediate application to pest and weed resistance management, our findings contribute to a broader understanding of cooperative behavior among farmers in the presence of strategic uncertainty.
abstract_zh: 摘要 我们与美国佛罗里达州柑橘种植户及阿根廷大豆种植户合作开展了两项框架田野经济实验，旨在探究农户参与病虫害与杂草协同治理的意愿。尽管两国农业情境存在显著差异，但研究发现惊人的行为共性：两国农户均表现出对战略不确定性的规避倾向，其参与决策高度依赖对邻居行为的信念，且即便机会成本较低时仍系统性低估协同成功的概率。这些跨情境的共性发现表明，潜在机制并非情境特异性，而是反映了战略依存条件下决策的普遍特征，从而支持了研究结论的外部有效性。研究结果揭示了阻碍合作的关键心理与经济壁垒，为设计提升自愿性区域病虫害协同治理项目参与度的干预措施提供了政策启示。尽管自愿协同能提升病虫害治理效率并实现帕累托最优，但集体行动的成功取决于能否克服农户的参与惰性。农户在机会成本较低时仍系统性低估协同成功概率的证据，凸显了导致协同失灵的关键行为障碍。通过定向补贴或技术援助等缓解战略不确定性、建立参与者信任的干预措施，可促使原本不愿参与协同行动的农户加入。除直接应用于病虫害抗性治理外，本研究还为理解战略不确定性下农户合作行为提供了更广泛的理论视角。

title: Brazil's VAT Reform: Improving Equity
title_zh: 巴西增值税改革：提升公平性
authors: Ana Cebreiro Gomez & Ms. Christina Kolerus
official: 官方在线 2026-06-26 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: After decades in the making, Brazil’s landmark VAT reform was approved in 2023. The primary objective of the reform is to eliminate distortions and reduce the complexity of the current consumption tax system while maintaining revenue neutrality. In addition, specific design features were included to alleviate the VAT’s inherent regressivity and improve the equity of the Brazilian tax system. This paper assesses the reform’s expected equity print leveraging a microstatic model based on household data and simulates policy options to further improve distributional outcomes. While the new VAT achieves a fairly equal distribution of the tax burden across most income groups, the poorest still carry a heavier load in terms of their disposable income. Dissecting the impact by policy instrument, the reform’s approved reduced rates aggravate regressivity, while zero rates and the new cashback lower the tax burden for poorer households, under the revenue neutrality assumption. Overall, the combined use of these measures dampens the reform’s equity outcomes somewhat as a higher VAT reference rate is required on all other items to maintain revenue neutrality. The paper also shows that some equity improvements stem from the reform’s implied pivot towards taxing services. Finally, simulations show that focusing on and expanding the cashback could amplify equity gains by raising the poorest disposable income by 25 percent via reductions in their tax liability.
abstract_zh: 历经数十年酝酿，巴西里程碑式的增值税改革于2023年获批。此次改革的首要目标是在保持税收中性前提下，消除现行消费税体系的扭曲效应并降低其复杂性。此外，改革还纳入了特定设计特征，以缓解增值税固有的累退性，提升巴西税收体系的公平性。本文基于家庭数据的微观静态模型评估了改革预期的公平性影响，并模拟了进一步改善分配结果的备选政策方案。尽管新增值税制在多数收入群体间实现了较为均衡的税负分配，但最贫困群体在可支配收入层面仍承担着更重的负担。按政策工具分解影响可见：在税收中性假设下，改革批准的优惠税率加剧了累退性，而零税率与新推行的现金返还机制则降低了贫困家庭的税负。总体而言，这些措施的联合使用在一定程度上削弱了改革的公平性效果——为维持税收中性，所有其他商品需适用更高的增值税基准税率。本文还表明，部分公平性改善源于改革隐含的服务业征税重心转移。最后，模拟结果显示，聚焦并扩大现金返还机制可通过减少贫困群体税负使其可支配收入提升25%，从而放大公平性收益。

title: International Trade in an Uncertain World
title_zh: 不确定世界中的国际贸易
authors: Benny Kleinman, Ernest Liu, Stephen Redding, David Xu
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We develop a tractable quantitative model of international trade in which agents make bilateral investments in resilience under general equilibrium uncertainty. Under both complete and incomplete financial markets, we show that these bilateral investments solve a portfolio problem of choosing trade partners. Countries’ risk profiles become determinants of trade flows, income and welfare, whose first moments are affected by the second moments of productivity and trade costs. Changes in global economic uncertainty have heterogeneous effects across countries, depending on how they affect real hedging opportunities. The opening of trade can raise or reduce income volatility, but is revealed-preferred to autarky.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个可量化的国际贸易模型，其中经济主体在一般均衡不确定性下对韧性进行双边投资。在完全金融市场与不完全金融市场两种情形下，我们证明这些双边投资可归结为选择贸易伙伴的投资组合问题。国家的风险特征成为贸易流量、收入与福利的决定因素，而这些变量的第一矩受生产率与贸易成本第二矩的影响。全球经济不确定性的变化对不同国家产生异质性影响，其作用方向取决于这些变化如何影响实际对冲机会。贸易开放可能提高或降低收入波动性，但通过显示性偏好优于自给自足状态。

title: Climate Change and Crop Yields in India
title_zh: 气候变化与印度作物产量
authors: Shweta Gupta, Gaurav Datt, Shreekant Gupta
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: With an exhausting land frontier, raising agricultural production to meet future global demand for food is highly contingent on higher crop yields. Yet, continued yield growth is increasingly threatened by climate change. This paper presents new evidence on significant effects of climate change on yields across ten major crops for 563 districts of India over half a century. The impacts are larger than those in the literature not only for India, but also relative to global benchmarks. Larger impacts are attributable to our use of a dynamic specification to capture persistence and to making an allowance for nonlinearity of marginal effects. We estimate 1◦C higher temperature reduces the national average all-crop yield by 8%. For individual crops, yield losses are as high as 16% for maize and 19% for pearl millet. For individual districts, they range from under 1% to 39%
abstract_zh: 随着土地开发边界日趋饱和，提高农业生产以满足未来全球粮食需求高度依赖于作物单产的提升。然而，持续的单产增长正日益受到气候变化的威胁。本文基于印度563个地区半个世纪以来十种主要作物的数据，提供了气候变化对作物单产产生显著影响的新证据。其影响程度不仅超过现有文献中针对印度的研究结论，也高于全球基准水平。这种更显著的影响归因于我们采用动态模型来捕捉持续性效应，并允许边际效应存在非线性特征。研究估算表明，温度每升高1°C，全国所有作物平均单产将下降8%。就具体作物而言，玉米单产损失高达16%，珍珠粟达19%。就具体地区而言，单产损失幅度从不足1%到39%不等。
